solution.label: Solution or tsconfig
solution.summary: The .sln or .slnx file that groups the projects.
solution.text1: The .sln or .slnx file that groups the system's projects. Rastro compiles through it to know who calls whom, including the real implementation behind each interface.
solution.text2: If there is more than one, pick the one that contains the project with the entry point.
solution.text3: In an Angular project, the list shows the tsconfig (such as tsconfig.app.json) and the entry point is Component.method.

entry.label: Entry point
entry.summary: The method where the feature starts, such as Class.Method.
entry.text1: The method where the feature starts: the controller action that receives the request, the job's Execute or the message handler's Handle.
entry.text2: Write the class and the method: PedidosController.Criar. If two classes share that name, include the namespace: Loja.Api.Controllers.PedidosController.Criar.
entry.text3: A route (/api/pedidos) does not work, nor does a namespace without the class.

depth.text2: Where the limit cuts off, the path is marked in the graph, and you can continue from there later.
depth.help: How many call levels to follow. Beyond that, the path is marked so you can continue later.
